name: Kumano Hayatama Taisha
description: One of the three Kumano Sanzan grand shrines, standing at the mouth of the Kumano River with vivid vermillion buildings, a thousand-year-old sacred nagi tree, and the Kumano Shimpokan treasure museum. The shrine fills Shingu as the catalogue's missing Sanzan anchor.

en.name: Kumano Hayatama Taisha
en.description: One of the three Kumano Sanzan grand shrines, standing at the mouth of the Kumano River with vivid vermillion buildings, a thousand-year-old sacred nagi tree, and the Kumano Shimpokan treasure museum. The shrine fills Shingu as the catalogue's missing Sanzan anchor.
en.notes: The Shingu City Tourist Association lists grounds open sunrise to 17:00, the amulet office 8:00–17:00, and the Shimpokan 9:00–16:00, open year-round; the shrine is about 15 minutes on foot from JR Shingu Station.
en.reservation: Ordinary worship needs no reservation; check festival schedules before visiting.
en.parking: Free parking is available near the grounds per the city tourist association; confirm current lots on arrival.
en.openingHours: Grounds sunrise–17:00; amulet office 8:00–17:00; Kumano Shimpokan 9:00–16:00; open year-round.

ja.name: 熊野速玉大社
ja.description: 熊野川河口に立つ熊野三山の一つ。朱色の社殿、樹齢千年の御神木ナギ、神宝館を擁し、カタログに欠けていた新宮の熊野拠点として整備しました。
highlights: 樹齢千年のご神木ナギ
ja.notes: 新宮市観光協会は境内を日の出〜17:00、授与所を8:00〜17:00、神宝館を9:00〜16:00（年中無休）、JR新宮駅から徒歩約15分と案内しています。
ja.reservation: 通常の参拝に予約は不要です。祭事日程は訪問前にご確認ください。
ja.parking: 観光協会の案内では境内近くに無料駐車場があります。到着時に最新の駐車場をご確認ください。
